newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine oilseeds firm on Chicago weather.
newsitem.headline: Argentine oilseeds firm on Chicago weather.

text.p: Argentine cash oilseed prices firmed Thursday in line with weather-obsessed Chicago soybeans, which saw strong gains on dry weather concerns, dealers on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange said.
Argentine May soybeans were up $3-4 a tonne on buying that dealers said was speculative and could slam into reverse if rain forecasts change the weather panorama.
Wheat prices were mostly unchanged while maize firmed $1 a tonne for April, with sellers thin on the ground.
